# SpeedCheck by SolversPro

> Instant, free internet speed test. Auto-starts on page load — no clicks needed. Measures download speed, upload speed, and latency via Cloudflare's global edge network.

SpeedCheck is a minimalist internet speed test at [speedcheck.solverspro.com](https://speedcheck.solverspro.com). It automatically starts measuring your connection the moment you open the page. Results include download speed (Mbps), upload speed (Mbps), unloaded latency (ping in ms), and loaded latency (bufferbloat in ms).

## Key Facts

- Free, no account required, no ads, no tracking
- Powered by Cloudflare's edge network across 330+ cities worldwide
- Auto-starts on page load (like fast.com) — zero clicks required
- Measures download speed, upload speed, unloaded latency, and loaded latency
- Copy or share your results instantly
- Part of [SolversPro](https://solverspro.com) — 80+ free online tools for developers, math, finance, health, and networking

## How It Works

SpeedCheck uses the official Cloudflare Speed Test engine. Your browser communicates directly with Cloudflare's nearest edge datacenter using multiple parallel HTTPS requests with dynamic payload sizes. This measures true end-to-end throughput without ISP caching interference.

The test runs three phases:
1. **Latency** — Measures unloaded ping and jitter to the nearest edge
2. **Download** — Tests downstream bandwidth with increasing payload chunks
3. **Upload** — Tests upstream bandwidth to the edge network

## What Metrics Mean

- **Download Speed (Mbps)** — How fast data transfers from the internet to your device. 25+ Mbps recommended for 4K streaming.
- **Upload Speed (Mbps)** — How fast your device sends data. 5-10 Mbps recommended for video calls.
- **Latency / Ping (ms)** — Round-trip reaction time. Under 30 ms is ideal for gaming.
- **Loaded Latency (ms)** — Ping measured under heavy traffic. High values indicate bufferbloat.
